about.text: A fresh curd cheese from the Djurdjura heights in Kabylie, Algeria, made from cow colostrum. The colostrum is heated and coagulated in terracotta utensils coated with olive oil, and the curd is eaten as it is and kept no more than 6 days. The method is from one review and may belong to a neighbouring cheese.
